sections.heading: CubeLite
sections.text: CubeLite Kubernetes Context Aggregator Discover, switch, and manage Kubernetes contexts from a unified interface — fast, local‑first, and privacy‑respecting. Download for macOS All platforms Latest release: v0.5.0 📸 Screenshot coming soon

sections.heading: Features
sections.text: Features 🔀 Context Switching Switch active Kubernetes context with a single click and persist the change to disk automatically. 📂 Multi-Kubeconfig Resolves KUBECONFIG env paths, merges multiple files, and picks the first file's current-context. 🖥️ Lens-like GUI NavigationSplitView sidebar listing all contexts with a detail pane for Pods, Namespaces, and Deployments. 📌 Menu Bar Quick-Switch Click the status-bar icon to switch context without opening the main window — perfect for fast workflows. 🔒 Secure Credentials Bearer tokens and client certificates stored in the OS Keychain — never in

sections.heading: Architecture
sections.text: Architecture CubeLite is a monorepo with three independent layers — no runtime dependency between them. 🦀 Rust Core crates/cubelite-core Kubeconfig parsing, kube-rs client, resource types. Rust 1.82+, tokio, thiserror, anyhow. 🍎 macOS App apps/macos Native Swift 6 + SwiftUI menu-bar and main window. macOS 14+, Observation framework, direct URLSession to k8s API. 🖥️ Desktop App apps/desktop Cross-platform via Tauri v2 + Svelte 5 + TypeScript. shadcn-svelte, Tailwind v4, Vitest, Playwright. cubelite/ ├── crates/ │ └── cubelite-core/ ← Rust library ├── apps/ │ ├── desktop/ ← Tauri v2 + Svelte
